title_zh: 祓魔法典 第 4 章‧契約與傷害
orig_source: avesta.org，蓋爾德納校本轉寫（舊式羅馬轉寫）
en_source: 《東方聖書》第 4 卷，1880／美國版 1898；公有領域

segments.orig:
ýô naire nemangheñte
nôit nemô paiti-baraiti
tâyush nemanghô bavaiti
hazangha nemô-barahe aêshãmcit ithra vâ
asni ithra vâ xshafne maêthanahe hvâi pairi-geurvayeite!
segments.en:
He that does not restore a loan to the man who lent it, steals
the thing and robs the man.
This he doeth every day, every night, as long as he keep in his
house his neighbour's property, as though it were his own.
segments.zh:
凡不將借出之物歸還與貸與人者，盜竊此物並搶奪此人。
此人每日每夜如此行為，只要他將鄰人之物留在自己家中，如同他自己之物然。

segments.orig:
dâtare gaêthanãm astvaitinãm ashâum
caiti aête mithra tava ýat ahurahe mazdå, âat
mraot ahurô mazdå, xshvash ashâum zarathushtra
paoiryô vacahinô bityô zastâ-marshtô
thrityô pasu-mazô tûiryô staorô-mazô
puxdhô vîrô-mazô xshtvô dainghu-mazô,
[ýô dainghave hu-vaxshâi fradhemnahe varedhemnahe
xrathwemnahe suyamnahe].
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy
One! How many in number are thy contracts, O
Ahura Mazda?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'They are six in number,
O holy Zarathushtra. The first is the word-contract;
the second is the hand-contract;
the third is the contract to the amount of a sheep; the
fourth is the contract to the amount of an ox; the
fifth is the contract to the amount of a man [person]; the
sixth is the contract to the amount of a field, a field
in good land, a fruitful one, in good bearing.'
segments.zh:
物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！你的契約有幾許在數，阿胡拉‧馬茲達啊？
阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「聖者查拉圖斯特拉啊，它們有六許在數。第一為言辭契約；第二為手部契約；第三為羊隻價值之契約；第四為牛隻價值之契約；第五為人身價值之契約；第六為田地價值之契約，一良田之田地，一豐饒者，一佳有孕者。」

segments.orig:
vacô paoirîm mithrem kerenaoiti zastô-masô
adhât framarezaiti zastô-masô adhât añtare
urvaitya fradathaiti, pasu-zamô adhât framarezaiti
pasu-zamô adhât añtare urvaitya fradathaiti.
segments.en:
The word-contract is fulfilled by words of mouth. It is cancelled
by the hand-contracct; he shall give as damages the amount of
the hand-contract.
segments.zh: 言辭契約以口頭言辭履行。它為手部契約所解除；他應給予手部契約價值之賠償。

segments.orig:
staorô-mazô adhât framarezaiti staorô-
mazô adhât añtare urvaitya fradathaiti, vîrô-mazô
adhât framarezaiti vîrô- mazô adhât
añtare urvaitya fradathaiti, dainghu-mazô adhât
framarezaiti dainghu-mazô adhât añtare urvaitya
fradathaiti.
segments.en:
The hand-contract is cancelled by the sheep-contract; he shall
give as damages the amount of the sheep-contract. The sheep-contract
is cancelled by the ox-contract; he shall give as damages the
amount of the ox-contract. The ox-contract is cancelled by the
man-contract; he shall give as damages the amount of the man-contract.
The man-contract is cancelled by the field-contract; he shall
give as damages the amount of the field-contract.
segments.zh: 手部契約為羊隻契約所解除；他應給予羊隻契約價值之賠償。羊隻契約為牛隻契約所解除；他應給予牛隻契約價值之賠償。牛隻契約為人身契約所解除；他應給予人身契約價值之賠償。人身契約為田地契約所解除；他應給予田地契約價值之賠償。

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum cvat aêshô mithrô
aiwi-druxtô âstâraiti ýô vacahinô,
âat mraot ahurô mazdå, thrish satâish
hadha-cithanãm narãm nabânazdishtanãm
para-baraiti.
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! If a man break
the word-contract, how many are involved in his sin?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'His sin makes his
Nabanazdishtas answerable for three hundred
(years).'

物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！若一人違背言辭契約，其罪涉及幾許者？

segments.orig:
ýô narsh snathem usehishtaiti aêtat hê
âgereptem ýat frashusaiti aêtat hê avaoirishtem
ýat dim aênô-manangha paiti-ashnaoiti aêtat
hê aredush, puxdhemcit nâ aredushãm tanûm
piryeite.
segments.en:
If a man rise up with a weapon in his
hand, it is an Agerepta. If he brandish it, it is
an Avaoirishta. If he actually smite
a man with malicious aforethought, it is an Aredush. Upon the
fifth Aredush he becomes a Peshotanu.
segments.zh: 若一男子持武器而起，此為阿格雷普塔。若他揮舞之，此為阿瓦歐瑞什塔。若他以惡意之心實際擊打一男子，此為阿雷杜什。於第五阿雷杜什，他成為佩紹坦努罪。

If a man commit an Agerepta for the eighth time, without having
atoned for the preceding, what penalty shall he pay?
Ahura Mazda answered: 'He is a Peshotanu: two hundred stripes
with the Aspahe-ashtra, two hundred stripes with the Sraosho-charana.'

segments.zh: 那裡對於這件事的痛苦將如同此世界中任何痛苦一樣難熬：即使好像有人用力將其易朽的身體頭朝下拋入懸崖，高度達人身高度的百倍，或更壞的情況；

segments.orig:
avadha aêtadha aêtahe shyaothnahe ýatha
vaêtheñti ýatha aêtahmi anghvô
ýat astvaiñti anusô pârem marezem ava-
hishtât.
segments.en:
down there the pain for that deed shall be as hard as any
in this world: even as if one should by force impale
his perishable body, or still worse.
segments.zh: 那裡對於這件事的痛苦將如同此世界中任何痛苦一樣難熬：即使好像有人用力刺穿其易朽的身體，或更壞的情況。

segments.orig:
avadha aêtadha aêtahe shyaothnahe ýatha
vaêtheñti ýatha aêtahmi anghvô
ýat astvaiñti âpem saokeñtavaitîm
zaranyâvaitîm vîthushavaitîm draogem vîthush
apâithish rashnaoshca paiti-sanghem mithraheca aiwi-druxtem.
segments.en:
Down there the pain for that deed shall
be as hard as any in this world: to wit, the deed of
a man, who knowingly lying, confronts the brimstoned,
golden, truth-knowing water with an
appeal unto Rashnu and a lie unto Mithra.
segments.zh: 那裡對於這件事的痛苦將如同此世界中任何痛苦一樣難熬：即一個人明知故犯地說謊，用對拉什努的訴求和對密特拉的謊言，去面對硫磺的、金色的、知真理的水。

segments.orig:
dâtare ... ashâum ýô âpem saokeñtavaitîm
zaranyâvaitîm vîthushavaitîm draogem vîthush
apâithish rashnaoshca paiti-sanghem mithraheca aiwi-druxtem
kâ-hê asti citha, âat mraot ahurô mazdå,
hapta sata upâzananãm upâzôit aspahe
ashtraya hapta sata sraoshô-caranaya! ashem vohû...!!
segments.en:
O Maker of the material world, thou Holy One! He who, knowingly
lying, confronts the brimstoned, golden, truth-knowing water with
an appeal unto Rashnu and a lie unto Mithra, what is the penalty
that he shall pay? Ahura
Mazda answered: 'Seven hundred stripes with the Aspahe-ashtra,
seven hundred stripes with the Sraosho-charana.'
segments.zh: 物質世界的造主啊，持阿沙的聖者啊！明知故犯地說謊，用對拉什努的訴求和對密特拉的謊言去面對硫磺的、金色的、知真理的水的人，他應當支付的懲罰是什麼？阿胡拉‧馬茲達答道：「用馬鞭鞭打七百下，用斯勞沙鞭鞭打七百下。」
